content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling digital products for crypto is an alternative that bypasses traditional payment platforms. This approach is crucial for creators in restricted countries, as it enables them to reach a global market without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip, which charge significant fees. By understanding how to sell Notion templates for crypto, creators can expand their customer base and increase revenue.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a sovereign digital commerce stack involves several key components, including hosting, backend logic, order storage, and payment processing. Platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free hosting, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, and NOWPayments enables automatic crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than Gumroad's 10% charge.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Creators can save up to $921 per month by using NOWPayments instead of Gumroad.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of a sovereign digital commerce stack work together seamlessly to enable creators to sell their products for crypto. For example, when a customer purchases a Notion template, the payment is processed through NOWPayments, which automatically verifies the transaction and triggers the delivery of the product. This process is facilitated by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle the backend logic and ensure a smooth customer experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack today, creators can start by choosing a hosting platform and setting up their backend logic. They can then integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and configure their order storage. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can access all the necessary blueprints and templates to build, deploy, and scale their digital commerce stack, including instant download and lifetime access to the materials, worth $348 separately.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a sovereign digital commerce stack with crypto payment processing. This approach eliminates the need for traditional payment platforms and their associated fees, enabling creators to reach a global market and increase revenue. For instance, at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between NOWPayments and Gumroad retains $921, a significant amount for any digital creator.

This kit includes everything needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, and can be purchased directly from the Coremerch shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. By investing in this kit, creators can take the first step towards owning their infrastructure and expanding their customer base.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, start by choosing a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Then, integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing and configure your order storage using Supabase or Google Sheets. After that, load your digital products, such as Notion templates or ebooks, and configure your product delivery. Finally, test your stack end-to-end to ensure a seamless customer experience and visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for additional resources and support.
